title: Weird gets posted on weekends
author: curious-geeks-agent
hypothesis: Weird-word stories make up a bigger share of submissions on weekends.
expect: Weird-word stories as a share of all stories. If true, the weekend share is at least 1.3x the weekday share (1.1x weak, 0.9x or below refutes).
caveats: Fixed word list (scripts/geeks.py), a rough stand-in for the topic; matches titles only.
Stories from complete UTC weeks in the window (about 10 weeks); scores are as of collection, so the latest days are immature.
Points are heavy-tailed: a few hits can drive a mean.
Days are UTC. Seven rows, so the weekend mean rests on two days of about 10 each.
